evidence.created: elementCreated records element and owner; NewModelToUpdate uses state 1
evidence.deleted: elementDeleted walks logical-tree includes and emits deleted/owner records
evidence.included: elementIncluded distinguishes created owner/child from existing reparent
evidence.reordered: elementReordered records owner and member unless member was created
evidence.attribute_plain: attributeModified(element, attribute) creates an empty qualifier
evidence.attribute_qualified: attributeModified(element, attribute, qualifier) stores qualifier map and dependencies
evidence.modified: ElementsModified walks the modified reference tree
evidence.combine: combine merges five change trees and qualifier maps
evidence.session_range: elementsChangedSince delegates to elementsChangedBetween; OWNER becomes include and primary-list changes become reorder plus ATT_MEMB
evidence.qualifier_replay: AttributesQualsModified replays all stored qualifiers for an element
